heroHeadline: 4,793 Fires, 4.1 Million Hectares Burned as Evacuation Orders Begin to Ease
heroSubtitle: As of the federal government's 18 August update, 582 wildfires remain active nationally (31 out of control) across 4,793 fires and over 4.1 million hectares burned this season. ~23,000 people have been evacuated overall, with ~11,000 still under evacuation order; 8,600 Indigenous people have been affected across 25 First Nations communities. Evacuation orders have eased in Peachland (14 Aug), Summerland (18 Aug) and Thunder Bay (20 Aug) as the Bald Range fire calms, while a previously undocumented fire, Bradley Creek near Vernon, burned over 2,600 hectares in early August before being held. Five deaths remain confirmed this season.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
